projects.title: Interactive Star Portfolio
projects.description: A modern interactive portfolio featuring custom star-shaped navigation, animation-driven UI, and a content-managed architecture built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Framer Motion.

projects.title: Spy – AI Text Detector
projects.description: A machine learning system trained on a custom 24,300-sample dataset that estimates the probability of a text being AI-generated, using Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression, and BERT models.

projects.title: Minik – Tiny House Platform
projects.description: A full-stack tiny house reservation and management system with role-based authorization, MSSQL database design using stored procedures and transactions, and RESTful APIs built on ASP.NET Core and React.

projects.title: HAVIZ – Izmir Weather Analytics
projects.description: A service-oriented weather analytics and forecasting system for the Izmir Konak region, combining XGBoost-based predictions with archived meteorological observations from the Turkish State Meteorological Service.

projects.title: CBULingo – Language Learning App
projects.description: A spaced-repetition English vocabulary learning application with progress tracking, built with React and JSON Server under tight time constraints as a solo rebuild of a team project.

projects.title: Pişti Recipe Platform
projects.description: A high-performance recipe discovery platform featuring 7000+ recipes, optimized search, advanced filtering, and a minimal user experience built with Next.js, MongoDB, Redis, and GSAP.
